verses.sloka: ततः सीतामुपागम्य राक्षस्यो विकृताननाः ।परुषं परुषा नार्य ऊचुस्ता वाक्यमप्रियम् ।। ५.२२.१।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sītāmupāgamya rākṣasyo vikṛtānanāḥ ।paruṣaṁ paruṣā nārya ūcustā vākyamapriyam ।। 5.22.1।।।।

translations.english: Hearing the sharp words of pleasing Sita, the lord of demons replied in unpleasant terms:

verses.sloka: किं त्वमन्तःपुरे सीते सर्वभूतमनोहरे ।महार्हशयनोपेते न वासमनुमन्यसे ।। ५.२२.२।।।।
verses.transliteration: kiṁ tvamantaḥpure sīte sarvabhūtamanohare ।mahārhaśayanopete na vāsamanumanyase ।। 5.22.2।।।।

translations.english: "The more the lover is courteous and loving and pleasing to women the more he is humiliated by them.
translations.hindi: जब राक्षसेन्द्र वहाँ से, निकल कर अपने भ्रन्तःपुर में पहुँच गया, तब वे भयंकर रूपधारिणी राक्षसियाँ सोता की ओर लपकीं

verses.sloka: मानुषी मानुषस्यैव भार्यात्वं बहु मन्यसे ।प्रत्याहर मनो रामान्न त्वं जातु भविष्यसि ।। ५.२२.३।।।।
verses.transliteration: mānuṣī mānuṣasyaiva bhāryātvaṁ bahu manyase ।pratyāhara mano rāmānna tvaṁ jātu bhaviṣyasi ।। 5.22.3।।।।

translations.english: "My love for you has restrained my anger, just as a good charioteer controls the horses galloping on a wrong path.
translations.hindi: प्रौर सीता के निकट पहुँच क्रुद्ध हो उनसे बड़े कठोर यह बच्चन . बोलीं

verses.sloka: मानुषी मानुषं तं तु राममिच्छसि शोभने ।राज्याद्भ्रष्टमसिद्धार्थं विक्लवं तमनिन्दिते ।। ५.२२.४।।।।
verses.transliteration: mānuṣī mānuṣaṁ taṁ tu rāmamicchasi śobhane ।rājyādbhraṣṭamasiddhārthaṁ viklavaṁ tamanindite ।। 5.22.4।।।।

translations.english: "Love is partial. It gets bound to those in whomsoever compassion and friendship is generated, even though they are punishable.

verses.sloka: राक्षसीनां वचः श्रुत्वा सीता पद्मनिभेक्षणा ।नेत्राभ्यामश्रुपूर्णाभ्यामिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ।। ५.२२.५।।।।
verses.transliteration: rākṣasīnāṁ vacaḥ śrutvā sītā padmanibhekṣaṇā ।netrābhyāmaśrupūrṇābhyāmidaṁ vacanamabravīt ।। 5.22.5।।।।

translations.english: "O beautiful one it is on this account that I do not kill you even though you deserve to be killed and insulted (for the words used), even as you are engaged in a pseudoascetic life.
translations.hindi: है विशालाक्षी ! उन्हीं विश्रवाजी का पुत्र रावण है, जो शत्रु को रुलाने वाला है । तुझको उसी राक्षसराज की पत्नी बन जाना चाहिए

verses.sloka: यदिदं लोकविद्विष्टमुदाहरथ सङ्गताः ।नैतन्मनसि वाक्यं मे किल्बिषं प्रतितिष्ठति ।। ५.२२.६।।।।
verses.transliteration: yadidaṁ lokavidviṣṭamudāharatha saṅgatāḥ ।naitanmanasi vākyaṁ me kilbiṣaṁ pratitiṣṭhati ।। 5.22.6।।।।

translations.english: "O Mythili for each of the piercing statements made you deserve dreadful death."
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर छोटे पेट वाली एकजटा नाम को राक्षसी क्रोध में भर और आँखें लाल-लाल कर श्रौर सीता को सम्बोधन कर, कहने लगी ॥(५॥॥ प्रजापतीनां षण्णां तु चतुर्थो यः प्रजापतिः । मानसो ब्रह्मणः पुत्रः पुलस्त्य इति विश्रुतः

verses.sloka: न मानुषी राक्षसस्य भार्या भवितुमर्हति ।कामं खादत मां सर्वा न करिष्यामि वो वचः ।दीनो वा राज्यहीनो वा यो मे भर्ता स मे गुरुः ।। ५.२२.७।।।।
verses.transliteration: na mānuṣī rākṣasasya bhāryā bhavitumarhati ।kāmaṁ khādata māṁ sarvā na kariṣyāmi vo vacaḥ ।dīno vā rājyahīno vā yo me bhartā sa me guruḥ ।। 5.22.7।।।।

translations.english: Ravana, the lord of demons, said these words in reply to Vaidehi who was overcome with anger and exitement.
translations.hindi: उन महर्षि पुलस्त्य के बड़े तेजस्वी मानसपुत्र विंश्रवा जी हैं, जो प्रजापति के समान प्रभावान्‌ हैं

verses.sloka: सीताया वचनं श्रुत्वा राक्षस्यः क्रोधमूर्छिताः ।भर्त्सयन्ति स्म परुषैर्वाक्यै रावणचोदिताः ।। ५.२२.८।।।।
verses.transliteration: sītāyā vacanaṁ śrutvā rākṣasyaḥ krodhamūrchitāḥ ।bhartsayanti sma paruṣairvākyai rāvaṇacoditāḥ ।। 5.22.8।।।।

translations.english: "I shall wait for two months, the deadline fixed. O lady of beautiful hue thereafter you have to share my bed.

verses.sloka: अवलीनः स निर्वाक्यो हनुमाञ्शिंशपाद्रुमे ।सीतां सन्तर्जयन्तीस्ता राक्षसीरशृणोत्कपिः ।। ५.२२.९।।।।
verses.transliteration: avalīnaḥ sa nirvākyo hanumāñśiṁśapādrume ।sītāṁ santarjayantīstā rākṣasīraśṛṇotkapiḥ ।। 5.22.9।।।।

translations.english: "If you are still reluctant to accept me as your husband after two months you will be sent to kitchen to be cooked as morning breakfast for me".

verses.sloka: तामभिक्रम्य संरब्धा वेपमानां समन्ततः ।भृशं संलिलिहुर्दीप्तान्प्रलम्बदशनच्छदान् ।। ५.२२.१०।।।।
verses.transliteration: tāmabhikramya saṁrabdhā vepamānāṁ samantataḥ ।bhṛśaṁ saṁlilihurdīptānpralambadaśanacchadān ।। 5.22.10।।।।

translations.english: Observing Janaki, threatened by the demon king the daughters of gods and gandharvas shed tears with distressful eyes.
translations.hindi: वह बिल्ली जैसी आँखों वालो हरिजटा कुषित हो और त्योरी चढ़ा कहने लगी--जिसने तैतीसों देवताग्रों को श्रौर उनके राजा इन्द्र तक को हरा दिया

verses.sloka: ऊचुश्च परमक्रुद्धाः प्रगृह्याशु परश्वधान् ।नेयमर्हति भर्तारं रावणं राक्षसाधिपम् ।। ५.२२.११।।।।
verses.transliteration: ūcuśca paramakruddhāḥ pragṛhyāśu paraśvadhān ।neyamarhati bhartāraṁ rāvaṇaṁ rākṣasādhipam ।। 5.22.11।।।।

translations.english: When Sita was threatened by the demon king, the daughters of gods and gandharvas there consoled her through gestures of their lips and eyes.
translations.hindi: नोट--यहाँ देवताग्रों की संख्यावाचक शब्द मयः त्रिंशत्‌ “(भ्र्थात्‌ ३३)” आया है । आरम्भ में या वैदिक काल में देवता ३३ ही थे । किन्तु पीछे पुण्य करने वाले मानवों ने स्वगे में प्रवेश कर, स्वग वासी होने क्रे कारण, स्वर्गवासियों की संख्या अत्यधिक बढ़ा दी । वह संख्या बढ़ती-बढ़ती ३३ से तेतीस करोड़ हो गई है । स्मरण रहे मूल तेतीस देवताओों को छोड़, शेष समस्त स्वर्गवासी जीव, देवता सरात्र होने पर भो--उन तेतीस मूल देवताश्रो की तरह, अजर अमर नहीं हे । शेष सब पुण्य क्षीण होने पर पुनः भूलोक में ज्ञाते है । मूल तैतीस देवता भो कभी कभी शापवश पृथिवी पर शाते हें श्रौर ज्ञाप का फल भोग पुनः अपने देवता रूप को प्राप्त होते हैं । यथा भीष्म, विदुर आदि की कथा पढो ] तस्य त्वं राक्षसेन्द्रस्य भार्या भवितुमहेसि । ततस्तु प्रघसा नाम राक्षसी क्रोधमूछिता

verses.sloka: सा भर्त्स्यमाना भीमाभी राक्षसीभिर्वरानना ।सा बाष्पमपमार्जन्ती शिंशपां तामुपागमत् ।। ५.२२.१२।।।।
verses.transliteration: sā bhartsyamānā bhīmābhī rākṣasībhirvarānanā ।sā bāṣpamapamārjantī śiṁśapāṁ tāmupāgamat ।। 5.22.12।।।।

translations.english: Having thus been consoled, Sita, proud of the power of her virtues, said this to Ravana in selfdefence:
translations.hindi: सीताजी को बुरी तरह डांटती डपटती हुई कहने लगी--देख, बड़े. पराक्रमी, शूर तथा युद्धक्षेत्र में कभी शत्रु को पीठ न दिखलाने वाले

verses.sloka: ततस्तां शिंशपां सीता राक्षसीभिः समावृता ।अभिगम्य विशालाक्षी तस्थौ शोकपरिप्लुता ।। ५.२२.१३।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatastāṁ śiṁśapāṁ sītā rākṣasībhiḥ samāvṛtā ।abhigamya viśālākṣī tasthau śokapariplutā ।। 5.22.13।।।।

translations.english: "Obviously there is no one among your people keen on your welfare since nobody is preventing you from this reproachable act.

verses.sloka: तां कृशां दीनवदनां मलिनाम्बरधारिणीम् ।भर्त्सयां चक्रिरे भीमा राक्षस्यस्ताः समन्ततः ।। ५.२२.१४।।।।
verses.transliteration: tāṁ kṛśāṁ dīnavadanāṁ malināmbaradhāriṇīm ।bhartsayāṁ cakrire bhīmā rākṣasyastāḥ samantataḥ ।। 5.22.14।।।।

translations.english: "Who in all the three worlds other than you would, even in mind, seek this consort of the righteous self (Sri Rama) like Sachi to Indra? .
translations.hindi: और सब स्त्रियों से बढ़ कर भाग्यवती मन्दोदरी को भी त्याग कर, तेरे ही साथ रहा करेगा । फिर हजारौं स्त्री रत्नों से भरे पूरे प्रौर नाना रत्नों से शोभित

verses.sloka: ततस्तां विनता नाम राक्षसी भीमदर्शना ।अब्रवीत्कुपिताकारा कराला निर्णतोदरी ।। ५.२२.१५।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatastāṁ vinatā nāma rākṣasī bhīmadarśanā ।abravītkupitākārā karālā nirṇatodarī ।। 5.22.15।।।।

translations.english: "O stupid demon where can you go to escape the consequences of your sinful words spoken against Rama's consort of undimmed brilliance?
translations.hindi: भ्रपने श्रन्तःपुर को त्याग, रावण तेरे वश हो जायगा । तदनन्तर एक दूसरी राक्षसी जिसका नाम विकटा था, कहने लगी

verses.sloka: सीते पर्याप्तमेतावद्भर्तृस्नेहो निदर्शितः ।सर्वत्रातिकृतं भद्रे व्यसनायोपकल्पते ।। ५.२२.१६।।।।
verses.transliteration: sīte paryāptametāvadbhartṛsneho nidarśitaḥ ।sarvatrātikṛtaṁ bhadre vyasanāyopakalpate ।। 5.22.16।।।।

translations.english: "It is like a proud elephant fighting in war with a rabbit. Rama is like an elephant and you are like an ordinary rabbit people speak of.
translations.hindi: , जिस रावण ने श्रनेक बार देवताग्रों, नागों, गन्धर्वी श्रौर दानवों को युद्ध. में परास्त किया, वह तेरे पास श्राया था

verses.sloka: परितुष्टास्मि भद्रं ते मानुषस्ते कृतो विधिः ।ममापि तु वचः पथ्यं ब्रुवन्त्याः कुरु मैथिलि ।। ५.२२.१७।।।।
verses.transliteration: parituṣṭāsmi bhadraṁ te mānuṣaste kṛto vidhiḥ ।mamāpi tu vacaḥ pathyaṁ bruvantyāḥ kuru maithili ।। 5.22.17।।।।

translations.english: "You are not ashamed of belittling Rama in his absence. You have not yet walked into his sight.
translations.hindi: हे ्रधमे-! ऐसे सब प्रकार. से समृद्धशाली मंहाबली राक्षसराज रावण -की पत्नी भ्रब तू क्यों बनना नहीं चाहती ?

verses.sloka: रावणं भज भर्तारं भर्तारं सर्वरक्षसाम् ।विक्रान्तं रूपवन्तं च सुरेशमिव वासवम् ।। ५.२२.१८।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇaṁ bhaja bhartāraṁ bhartāraṁ sarvarakṣasām ।vikrāntaṁ rūpavantaṁ ca sureśamiva vāsavam ।। 5.22.18।।।।

translations.english: "O ignoble wretch I wonder why your dark brown, distorted eyes do not fall off (the socket) when you look at me (lustfully).
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर दुम'खी नाम की राक्षसो कहने लगी । जिसके डर से न तो सूयं (अधिक) तपता भ्रौर न वायु ही (बहुत तेजी के साथ) बहता है, उसके वश गें तू क्यों नहीं हो जाती ? जिसके भय से पेड़ फूलों की दृष्टि किया करते हुँ

verses.sloka: दक्षिणं त्यागशीलं च सर्वस्य प्रियवादिनम् ।मानुषं कृपणं रामं त्यक्त्वा रावणमाश्रय ।। ५.२२.१९।।।।
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇaṁ tyāgaśīlaṁ ca sarvasya priyavādinam ।mānuṣaṁ kṛpaṇaṁ rāmaṁ tyaktvā rāvaṇamāśraya ।। 5.22.19।।।।

translations.english: "Why does not your tongue drop down while you speak such words against this consort of the righteous king (Rama) and daughterin law of Dasaratha?

verses.sloka: दिव्याङ्गरागा वैदेहि दिव्याभरणभूषिता ।अद्य प्रभृति सर्वेषां लोकानामीश्वरी भव ।अग्नेः स्वाहा यथा देवी शचीवेन्द्रस्य शोभने ।। ५.२२.२०।।।।
verses.transliteration: divyāṅgarāgā vaidehi divyābharaṇabhūṣitā ।adya prabhṛti sarveṣāṁ lokānāmīśvarī bhava ।agneḥ svāhā yathā devī śacīvendrasya śobhane ।। 5.22.20।।।।

translations.english: "O Ravana I can reduce you to ashes through the fire of my chastity. But I do not have Rama's permission and I want to preserve my power of ascetism even though you are fit to be consigned to the flames.
translations.hindi: । प्रौर पर्वत पानी बहाया करते हे ग्रौर जब रावण चाहता है तब मेघ पानी ' बरसाया करते हैं; उस राक्षसराज रावण की पत्नी बनना तू क्यों पसंद नहीं करती ?

verses.transliteration: kiṁ te rāmeṇa vaidehi kṛpaṇena gatāyuṣā ।। 5.22.21।।।।

translations.english: "When I was with wise Rama, it was not possible for you to abduct me. No doubt Providence has ordained this to bring about your death.

verses.sloka: एतदुक्तं च मे वाक्यं यदि त्वं न करिष्यसि ।अस्मिन्मुहूर्ते सर्वास्त्वां भक्षयिष्यामहे वयम् ।।५.२२.२२।।।।
verses.transliteration: etaduktaṁ ca me vākyaṁ yadi tvaṁ na kariṣyasi ।asminmuhūrte sarvāstvāṁ bhakṣayiṣyāmahe vayam ।।5.22.22।।।।

translations.english: "You are a (great) warrior and a brother of Kubera. You possess an army. Then why did you abduct Rama's wife bypassing him?"

verses.sloka: अन्या तु विकटा नाम लम्बमानपयोधरा ।अब्रवीत्कुपिता सीतां मुष्टिमुद्यम्य गर्जती ।। ५.२२.२३।।।।
verses.transliteration: anyā tu vikaṭā nāma lambamānapayodharā ।abravītkupitā sītāṁ muṣṭimudyamya garjatī ।। 5.22.23।।।।

translations.english: On hearing Janaki, the lord of demons, Ravana looked at her with his cruel eyes opened wide and rolling.

verses.sloka: बहून्यप्रतिरूपाणि वचनानि सुदुर्मते ।अनुक्रोशान्मृदुत्वाच्च सोढानि तव मैथिलि ।न च नः कुरुषे वाक्यं हितं कालपुरस्कृतम् ।। ५.२२.२४।।।।
verses.transliteration: bahūnyapratirūpāṇi vacanāni sudurmate ।anukrośānmṛdutvācca soḍhāni tava maithili ।na ca naḥ kuruṣe vākyaṁ hitaṁ kālapuraskṛtam ।। 5.22.24।।।।

translations.english: Prosperous Ravana looked like a mass of dark cloud, with strong arms, stout neck, gait of a lion, a blazing tongue and burning eyes

verses.sloka: आनीतासि समुद्रस्य पारमन्यैर्दुरासदम् ।रावणान्तःपुरं घोरं प्रविष्टा चासि मैथिलि ।। ५.२२.२५।।।।
verses.transliteration: ānītāsi samudrasya pāramanyairdurāsadam ।rāvaṇāntaḥpuraṁ ghoraṁ praviṣṭā cāsi maithili ।। 5.22.25।।।।

translations.english: He appeared taller with an unsteady crown. He was wearing wonderful red flower garlands and clothes and was smeared with unguents, shining in ornamental armlets.

verses.sloka: रावणस्य गृहे रुधा अस्माभिस्तु सुरक्षिता ।न त्वां शक्तः परित्रातुमपि साक्षात्पुरन्दरः ।। ५.२२.२६।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇasya gṛhe rudhā asmābhistu surakṣitā ।na tvāṁ śaktaḥ paritrātumapi sākṣātpurandaraḥ ।। 5.22.26।।।।

translations.english: Wrapped well with a big black thread around his hips, he appeared like mount Mandara encompassed by a black serpent at the time of churning the milkocean for nectar.

verses.sloka: कुरुष्व हितवादिन्या वचनं मम मैथिलि ।अलमश्रुप्रपातेन त्यज शोकमनर्थकम् ।। ५.२२.२७।।।।
verses.transliteration: kuruṣva hitavādinyā vacanaṁ mama maithili ।alamaśruprapātena tyaja śokamanarthakam ।। 5.22.27।।।।

translations.english: The lord of demons shone like mount Mandara, both his long two arms like two mountain peaks.

verses.sloka: भज प्रीतिं प्रहर्षं च त्यजैतां नित्यदैन्यताम् ।सीते राक्षसराजेन सह क्रीड यथासुखम् ।। ५.२२.२८।।।।
verses.transliteration: bhaja prītiṁ praharṣaṁ ca tyajaitāṁ nityadainyatām ।sīte rākṣasarājena saha krīḍa yathāsukham ।। 5.22.28।।।।

translations.english: He stood like a mountain with two Ashoka trees clothed with red leaves and flowers in the form of earrings of the colour of the rising Sun.

verses.sloka: जानासि हि यथा भीरु स्त्रीणां यौवनमध्रुवम् ।यावन्न ते व्यतिक्रामेत्तावत्सुखमवाप्नुहि ।। ५.२२.२९।।।।
verses.transliteration: jānāsi hi yathā bhīru strīṇāṁ yauvanamadhruvam ।yāvanna te vyatikrāmettāvatsukhamavāpnuhi ।। 5.22.29।।।।

translations.english: He was comparable to the wishfulfilling tree grown in heaven, a personified spring season and a memorial structure raised on the cremation ground. He looked frightening even though welladorned.

verses.sloka: उद्यानानि च रम्याणि पर्वतोपवनानि च ।सह राक्षसराजेन चर त्वं मदिरेक्षणे ।। ५.२२.३०।।।।
verses.transliteration: udyānāni ca ramyāṇi parvatopavanāni ca ।saha rākṣasarājena cara tvaṁ madirekṣaṇe ।। 5.22.30।।।।

translations.english: Looking at Vaidehi, eyes red with anger, and breathing heavily like a histing snake, Ravana replied:

verses.sloka: स्त्रीसहस्राणि ते सप्त वशे स्थास्यन्ति सुन्दरि ।रावणं भज भर्तारं भर्तारं सर्वरक्षसाम् ।। ५.२२.३१।।।।
verses.transliteration: strīsahasrāṇi te sapta vaśe sthāsyanti sundari ।rāvaṇaṁ bhaja bhartāraṁ bhartāraṁ sarvarakṣasām ।। 5.22.31।।।।

translations.english: "O Sita you are following a vow of chastity and treading a meaningless, wrong path. I will destroy you as the Sun dispels the morning twilight with his lustre".

verses.sloka: उत्पाट्य वा ते हृदयं भक्षयिष्यामि मैथिलि ।यदि मे व्याहृतं वाक्यं न यथावत्करिष्यसि ।। ५.२२.३२।।।।
verses.transliteration: utpāṭya vā te hṛdayaṁ bhakṣayiṣyāmi maithili ।yadi me vyāhṛtaṁ vākyaṁ na yathāvatkariṣyasi ।। 5.22.32।।।।

translations.english: King Ravana, a tormentor of enemies, having thus threatened Mythili commanded the shedemons women of fiecrceful appearance as follows:

verses.sloka: ततश्चण्डोदरी नाम राक्षसी क्रूरदर्शना ।भ्रामयन्ती महच्छूलमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ।। ५.२२.३३।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataścaṇḍodarī nāma rākṣasī krūradarśanā ।bhrāmayantī mahacchūlamidaṁ vacanamabravīt ।। 5.22.33।।।।

translations.english: Of them one had one eye, the other one ear, another with ears covered, one had the ear of a cow, another had ears of an elephant and yet another, long, hanging ears. One had the feet of an elephant, another, hoofs of a horse and still another of a cow. While one had a single foot, another had broad feet and yet another no feet at all. One had a long neck and a large head. One had large breasts and belly. One had a big face and eyes, another had a long tongue and yet another no tongue at all. One had no nose and still another had a lion face and yet another the face of a cow.

verses.sloka: इमां हरिणलोकाक्षीं त्रासोत्कम्पपयोधराम् ।रावणेन हृतां दृष्ट्वा दौर्हृदो मे महानभूत् ।। ५.२२.३४।।।।
verses.transliteration: imāṁ hariṇalokākṣīṁ trāsotkampapayodharām ।rāvaṇena hṛtāṁ dṛṣṭvā daurhṛdo me mahānabhūt ।। 5.22.34।।।।

translations.english: Of them one had one eye, the other one ear, another with ears covered, one had the ear of a cow, another had ears of an elephant and yet another, long, hanging ears. One had the feet of an elephant, another, hoofs of a horse and still another of a cow. While one had a single foot, another had broad feet and yet another no feet at all. One had a long neck and a large head. One had large breasts and belly. One had a big face and eyes, another had a long tongue and yet another no tongue at all. One had no nose and still another had a lion face and yet another the face of a cow.

verses.sloka: यकृत्प्लीहमथोत्पीडं हृदयं च सबन्धनम् ।अन्त्राण्यपि तथा शीर्षं खादेयमिति मे मतिः ।। ५.२२.३५।।।।
verses.transliteration: yakṛtplīhamathotpīḍaṁ hṛdayaṁ ca sabandhanam ।antrāṇyapi tathā śīrṣaṁ khādeyamiti me matiḥ ।। 5.22.35।।।।

translations.english: Of them one had one eye, the other one ear, another with ears covered, one had the ear of a cow, another had ears of an elephant and yet another, long, hanging ears. One had the feet of an elephant, another, hoofs of a horse and still another of a cow. While one had a single foot, another had broad feet and yet another no feet at all. One had a long neck and a large head. One had large breasts and belly. One had a big face and eyes, another had a long tongue and yet another no tongue at all. One had no nose and still another had a lion face and yet another the face of a cow.

verses.sloka: ततस्तु प्रघसा नाम राक्षसी वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।कण्ठमस्या नृशंसायाः पीडयामः किमास्यते ।। ५.२२.३६।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatastu praghasā nāma rākṣasī vākyamabravīt ।kaṇṭhamasyā nṛśaṁsāyāḥ pīḍayāmaḥ kimāsyate ।। 5.22.36।।।।

translations.english: "O demonesses, all of you jointly dispose Janaki towards me. See that she submits to me at once.

verses.sloka: निवेद्यतां ततो राज्ञे मानुषी सा मृतेति ह ।नात्र कश्चन सन्देहः खादतेति स वक्ष्यति ।। ५.२२.३७।।।।
verses.transliteration: nivedyatāṁ tato rājñe mānuṣī sā mṛteti ha ।nātra kaścana sandehaḥ khādateti sa vakṣyati ।। 5.22.37।।।।

translations.english: "By adopting means favourable or contrary to her will or through persuasion or coercion or through reward or punishment, draw Vaidehi's mind towards me." (said Ravana).

verses.sloka: ततस्त्वजामुखी नाम राक्षसी वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।विशस्येमां ततः सर्वान्समान्कुरुत पीलुकान् ।। ५.२२.३८।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatastvajāmukhī nāma rākṣasī vākyamabravīt ।viśasyemāṁ tataḥ sarvānsamānkuruta pīlukān ।। 5.22.38।।।।

translations.english: The demon king repeatedly commanded the ogresses burning in anger and passion and threatened Sita again and again, pointing his finger at her.

verses.sloka: विभजाम ततः सर्वा विवादो मे न रोचते ।पेयमानीयतां क्षिप्रं माल्यं च विविधं बहु ।। ५.२२.३९।।।।
verses.transliteration: vibhajāma tataḥ sarvā vivādo me na rocate ।peyamānīyatāṁ kṣipraṁ mālyaṁ ca vividhaṁ bahu ।। 5.22.39।।।।

translations.english: An ogress called Dhanyamalini at once approached the tenheaded Ravana and embracing him, said:.

verses.sloka: ततः शूर्पणखा नाम राक्षसी वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।अजामुखा यदुक्तं हि तदेव मम रोचते ।। ५.२२.४०।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śūrpaṇakhā nāma rākṣasī vākyamabravīt ।ajāmukhā yaduktaṁ hi tadeva mama rocate ।। 5.22.40।।।।

translations.english: "O king of demons, sport with me, my lord. What purpose will be served with this pale wretched Sita, a human being after all?

verses.sloka: सुरा चानीयतां क्षिप्रं सर्वशोकविनाशिनी ।मानुषं मांसमासाद्य नृत्यामोऽथ निकुम्भिलाम् ।। ५.२२.४१।।।।
verses.transliteration: surā cānīyatāṁ kṣipraṁ sarvaśokavināśinī ।mānuṣaṁ māṁsamāsādya nṛtyāmo'tha nikumbhilām ।। 5.22.41।।।।

translations.english: "O king surely she is not ordained by Brahma, the foremost among the immortals to enjoy the luxuries earned by the strength of your arms.

verses.sloka: एवं सम्भर्त्स्यमाना सा सीता सुरसुतोपमा ।राक्षसीभिः सुघोराभिर्धैर्यमुत्सृज्य रोदिति ।। ५.२२.४२।।
verses.transliteration: evaṁ sambhartsyamānā sā sītā surasutopamā ।rākṣasībhiḥ sughorābhirdhairyamutsṛjya roditi ।। 5.22.42।।

translations.english: The body of a man who desires a woman without desire is only tormented; but for one who desires a willing woman, the pleasure is delightful.
